crmWrites.mechanism: SDK (CrmProxy.Create email, followed by service.Execute OrganizationRequest 'SendEmail' {EmailId, TrackingToken="", IssueSend=true})
crmWrites.recordKey: New record (service.Create returns emailid); no lookup of existing e-mails - one e-mail per input row, no deduplication.

declaredRowFilters.field: Get Data From Employer Enrolment & Fundmain: gen_currentstate
declaredRowFilters.via: Package\Send Email\Get Data From Employer Enrolment & Fundmain
declaredRowFilters.why: Source SQL (CRM DB, filtered views): Gen_employerenrolment ee JOIN Gen_fundmain fm ON customer id numbers equal after stripping leading zeros/spaces (SUBSTRING(x, PATINDEX('%[^0 ]%', x + ' '), LEN(x)) on both sides) JOIN product p ON p.ProductId = fm.gen_fundtypename JOIN Account a ON ee.gen_employersnumber = a.AccountId LEFT JOIN Gen_employers e ON e.Gen_employersId = fm.gen_employernumber AND a.AccountNumber = e.Gen_CorporateNumber WHERE gen_currentstate = 1 AND gen_employerdepositdate <= fm.Gen_FundCreationDate AND ee.CreatedOn >= GETDATE()-7 AND ((p.gen_subproduct = 1 AND ee.gen_producttype = 1) OR (p.gen_subproduct = 4 AND ee.gen_producttype = 2) OR (p.gen_subproduct = 2 AND ee.gen_producttype = 3)) AND fm.Gen_existinfile = 1. One row per (enrolment, matching fund): an enrolment matching several funds yields several e-mails.

crmWrites.condition: Row reaches the writer via 'Check If To Send Mail' Output 0 (see declaredRowFilters), then inside Input0_ProcessInputRow the e-mail is created only when Row.gendeposittype == 1 (to = Gvia queue) or == 2 (to = Maasikim queue); any other value: nothing is created (main.cs:86-95). After Create, SendEmail is executed immediately (main.cs:154-156, 161-171). NULL handling (DTSX fact + general SSIS/.NET knowledge, not verified at runtime): the BufferWrapper getters read the columns with Buffer.GetString / GetGuid / GetInt32 and no NULL check (DTSX:6819-6823 employerenrolment_customeridnumber, 6849-6853 gen_fundnumber, 6879-6883 Gen_customername, 6894-6898 Gen_employerenrolmentId, 6909-6913 gen_deposittype, 6924-6928 EmployerNumber). main.cs:78-83 (DTSX:6409-6414) reads all of them unconditionally before the deposit-type test, and per documented SSIS behaviour reading a NULL column value throws ColumnIsNullException. The catch(Exception ex) then evaluates ex.InnerException.Message (main.cs:112, DTSX:6443); with no InnerException this throws NullReferenceException inside the catch, so the component - and the 'Send Email' data flow - fails. The same applies to a NULL gen_deposittype (main.cs:86/91) and to an invalid/empty queue id in User::MaasikimQueueId / User::GviaQueueId (new Guid(...) throws FormatException, main.cs:75-76). A NULL in any of these columns therefore never yields an e-mail with empty text; it aborts processing.

attributes.expression: email["regardingobjectid"] = new EntityReference(toEntityName1, employerEnrolment.EmployerEnrolmentGuid) with toEntityName1 = "gen_employerenrolment" and EmployerEnrolmentGuid = Row.GenemployerenrolmentId (ee.Gen_employerenrolmentId). Unchanged GUID. A NULL gen_deposittype does not skip the row silently: it throws and fails the component (see NULL handling in this writer's condition; general SSIS/.NET semantics).

SetMailSubject(EmployerEnrolmentId, EmployerEnrolmentName, EmployerEnrolmentFundNumber) => FundNumber + "," + CustomerName + "," + CustomerId + "-התראה בגין מסך שגויים " where FundNumber = Row.genfundnumber (fm.gen_fundnumber), CustomerName = Row.Gencustomername (ee.Gen_customername), CustomerId = Row.employerenrolmentcustomeridnumber (ee.gen_customeridnumber, not zero-stripped). The three columns are never NULL in a created e-mail: a NULL in any of them throws while reading the row (see the NULL handling note in this writer's condition) and fails the component (general SSIS/.NET semantics, hypothesis at runtime).

SetMailBody(...) builds HTML: "" + "תז-" + EmployerEnrolmentId (Row.employerenrolmentcustomeridnumber) + "
" + "שם מלא לקוח - " + EmployerEnrolmentName (Row.Gencustomername) + "
" + "ח.פ מעסיק -" + EmployerEnrolmentEmployerId (Row.EmployerNumber = a.AccountNumber of the enrolment's employer account) + "
" + " מספר קופה שנפתחה -" + EmployerEnrolmentFundNumber (Row.genfundnumber) + "
" + "סכום הפקדה שגוי - " + EmployerEnrolmentIncorrectDepositAmount + "
" + "בברכה, מחלקת מעסיקים" + "". EmployerEnrolmentIncorrectDepositAmount = !Row.genincorrectamount_IsNull ? Row.genincorrectamount.ToString() : null (decimal/currency ToString with the host's current culture; never NULL here because Check If To Send Mail drops NULL amounts). NULL handling: employerenrolment_customeridnumber, Gen_customername, EmployerNumber and gen_fundnumber are read via Buffer.GetString without a NULL check (only gen_incorrectamount is guarded by _IsNull); a NULL in any of them throws ColumnIsNullException while building EmployerEnrolment (main.cs:78-82) and, through the catch's ex.InnerException.Message, fails the component - it is never rendered as empty text (DTSX fact for the code; exception behaviour = general SSIS/.NET knowledge, not verified at runtime).

notes: Writers in lineage: 4 script writers. Mapped: 1 (Send Email\Send Email To Maasikim: email CREATE + SendEmail request, 6 attributes). Excluded as ETL plumbing: Send Email\ETL Warning 1 2 1 and its byte-identical copy ETL Warning 1 2 1 1 (gen_etlprocesswarning creates, dupes.json), End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish (gen_etlprocess update); also the Script Task 'Create ETL Process record' and the variable-loading flow 'Get Variables From Etl Varibles'.

Besides creating the e-mail, the script immediately executes the CRM message SendEmail (IssueSend=true, TrackingToken="") on the new e-mail - this changes the e-mail state to sent/pending send in CRM; it is a CRM action, not an attribute assignment (main.cs:156, 161-171 / DTSX:6487, 6492-6502).
Input column gen_employernumber (fm.gen_employernumber) is passed to the writer but never referenced in its code (only Row.EmployerNumber = a.AccountNumber is used for the 'ח.פ מעסיק' line).

Duplicates: the SQL joins enrolment to fund on the zero-stripped customer id number; an enrolment with several matching funds (passing the filters) produces several e-mails per run, and because the window is ee.CreatedOn >= GETDATE()-7, the same enrolment is re-mailed on every daily run for 7 days (no 'already sent' flag is read or written in this package). Fact = SQL text; operational impact = hypothesis (depends on schedule).

Error handling (code = DTSX fact; runtime behaviour = general SSIS/.NET knowledge, not verified): any exception in Input0_ProcessInputRow - including ColumnIsNullException from reading a NULL employerenrolment_customeridnumber / gen_fundnumber / Gen_customername / EmployerNumber / gen_deposittype (GetString/GetInt32 without NULL check, DTSX:6819-6928) and FormatException from an invalid queue GUID variable - reaches catch(Exception ex), which reads ex.InnerException.Message; with no InnerException this throws NullReferenceException inside the catch and fails the component and the data flow (remaining rows get no e-mail; e-mails already created/sent stay). Only exceptions with an InnerException not containing 'token' are routed to the Error output (ETL warning). SoapException branch sets Row.ErrorMessage but does NOT call DirectRowToError. Retry counter is never reset. If Create succeeds and SendEmail fails, the e-mail remains in CRM unsent.
Check If To Send Mail reads Row.genselfemployed without an _IsNull check; per SSIS buffer semantics a NULL here raises an exception (hypothesis, not verified at runtime).
